name: wurl
description: curl for WebRTC: join a PSP site as a browserless peer and report every step

scripts.vendor:peerpigeon: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {execSync}=require('child_process');const sha=execSync('git -C ../PeerPigeon rev-parse --short HEAD').toString().trim();fs.writeFileSync('src/vendor/peerpigeon.js','// PeerPigeon '+sha+' (https://github.com/PeerPigeon/PeerPigeon), its built dist/index.js.\\n// Refresh with: npm run vendor:peerpigeon (copies ../PeerPigeon/dist/index.js).\\n'+fs.readFileSync('../PeerPigeon/dist/index.js','utf8'));fs.copyFileSync('../PeerPigeon/dist/index.d.ts','src/vendor/peerpigeon.d.ts');console.log('vendored PeerPigeon '+sha)"
